parameters.name: Dimensions
parameters.description: Set of labels for the metric.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: End time. Default is the current time.

parameters.name: MetricType
parameters.description:
Type of metric. Valid values:

- NetworkReceiveBytesPerSecond: Bytes received per second over the network.

- NetworkTransmitBytesPerSecond: Bytes sent per second over the network.

- FrontendThroughputBytes: Frontend service throughput in bytes.

- FrontendLatencyMicrosecond: Frontend service latency in microseconds.

- FrontendIops: Frontend service read frequency (IOPS).

parameters.name: SlotId
parameters.description: ID of the dataset acceleration slot that owns the metrics. To get a slot ID, see [ListSlots](~~467905~~).

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: Start time. Default is one hour before now.
